_meta.description: Hand-curated X (Twitter) posts, newest first. Each post is printed as a ruled row (date, author, text); X's script loads only when a reader asks for one full post with its photos. 'status' grades the post's claims, not the account: posts by enthusiasts are 'reported' at best; posts by MahaMetro's Thane Metro account (@MetroRailThane) count as verified. Picked by the owner, 2026-11-03.

posts.author: Sunny
posts.text: Piling has officially begun on the Thane Integral Ring Metro, with photos (credited to Kota Ganesh).

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: Soil testing has reached Raila Devi, where phase 1 starts; it is the last stage of soil testing. With photos.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: MahaMetro has invited bids for the detailed design of the underground section: architecture and E&M, tunnel ventilation with fire and airflow simulations, environmental control and building management.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: The Environment Ministry has given the project its Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) clearance.

posts.author: Sunny
posts.text: Only two firms bid for the detailed design of 12 elevated stations: STUP Consultants and SYSTRA MVA Consulting (India).

posts.author: Artful Dodger
posts.text: MahaMetro invited bids for a design consultant for the two underground stations: Thane Junction at Thane suburban station, and New Thane at the Kopri bridge.
